meta.name: Whos Your Gynac
meta.description:
Dr Vidushi Kothari, a 28-year-old optimistic OB-GYN struggles with her personal and professional problems while solving clinical cases that come her way

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5

videos.title: A Pregnancy Test and a Pregnancy Case
videos.overview: While Dr. Vidushi desperately seeks a pregnancy case for her clinic, a 21-year-old visits her with a pregnancy scare.

videos.title: Gulab Jamun and a Birthday Cake
videos.overview: A newly married couple having issues in intimacy visits Dr. Vidushi, who is dealing with her own string of embarrassing encounters in the pursuit of impressing Nurse Violet.

videos.title: A Chat Group and a Tea Set
videos.overview: Vidushi approaches her alma mater school principal to propose a period study program that swings into an uncomfortable predicament later on.

videos.title: A Broken Pipe and a Dahi
videos.overview: The book of tension between Arth and Vidushi leaves no page unturned until Vidushi comes across a female patient dealing with UTI.

videos.title: A Yellow Saree and a Doppler
videos.overview: Swara anxiously awaits her mother to reach for her Valaikappu(baby shower). Life comes full circle for Vidushi as she will have to step up as Swara's Gynac and best friend.

videos.title: Doctorpreneur
videos.overview: Vidushi fulfils a promise made to her father leading to unexpected after-effects, while a patient in pain seeks her counsel.

videos.title: Take A Chill On The Pill
videos.overview: Vidushi gets a new billboard for the clinic, Nurse Violet seeks new job opportunities and new mother Swara goes missing.

videos.title: Lost In Translation
videos.overview: Vidushi seeking affiliation for her clinic lands up at a doctor’s conference & a patient brings in a surprise secret.

videos.title: Hard Calls
videos.overview: Vidushi partners with Heartfelt Gynaecology Chains to save her clinic.

videos.title: It Takes A Village
videos.overview: A heartbroken Vidushi gears up to say goodbye to her clinic.
